summary: ```markdown # 1-Minute Tutorial Collection: Marvelous Designer Tips ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will explore how to check if the virtual model is correctly inserted into your scene in Marvelous Designer. This process is crucial for ensuring that your simulations run smoothly and effectively. ## Inserting the Character Model First, we will insert the character model into the scene. It is essential to select the correct insert unit, as choosing the wrong unit may cause several problems down the line. ### Checking the Floor Grid You can refer to the floor grid to gauge the size of the virtual model. It is important that the entire virtual model is approximately the same size as the floor grid. Typically, for virtual models, only one corner needs to be connected to two floor grids. ## Creating a Template Next, we will create a template for the virtual model. This template will help us identify and resolve any conflict problems that may occur during the simulation. ### Arranging the Template We will arrange the template around the virtual model and then proceed to look at the simulation. You might notice that the simulation quality is very low at this point. ## Understanding Simulation Issues The reason for the low simulation quality is that the template produced according to the model is too small. The particle diameter is too large, and the grid is too small, leading to a mismatch. Therefore, using too small virtual models can cause the different default values of the template to not align properly, resulting in various issues. ## Re-inserting the Virtual Model At this stage, we need to re-insert a larger unit into the virtual model. To facilitate this, we can add a default virtual model to the work area as a comparison reference. ### Comparing Sizes By comparing the sizes, we can see that the self-defined virtual model is the opposite of the default size. This discrepancy is crucial for achieving accurate simulations. ## Conclusion With this understanding, you can continue to make clothing using a properly sized virtual model. Correcting these initial setup issues will greatly enhance the quality of your simulations in Marvelous Designer. ```
